find.f_photo.title: Photo at the workbench
find.f_photo.text: An old snapshot: Grandpa stands at this very workbench in his work apron, laughing. Someone must have cracked a joke before he could put on a straight face.
find.f_screws.title: Box of screws
find.f_screws.text: Screws sorted by size, each slot labelled in his handwriting. Grandpa never threw anything away without a reason: everything comes in handy sooner or later.
find.f_note.title: Note in the cabinet
find.f_note.text: A folded slip between the shelves: "The most important thing is behind the cabinet." Grandpa's handwriting, a little hurried, as if he remembered it at the last minute.
find.f_radio.title: Evening tune
find.f_radio.text: The radio crackles and suddenly finds a familiar tune. Grandpa used to put it on in the evenings, after work, as he poured himself a cup of tea.
find.f_clock.title: Engraving on the clock
find.f_clock.text: An engraving on the back of the clock: "To the craftsman, with thanks from his first customer." It all started with this clock.
final.title: The workshop comes alive
final.text: The light is on, the clock is ticking, the radio plays softly. The workshop is alive again. And from behind the next door comes a smell of paint. Looks like there's more work to do.

find.f_drawing.title: Child's drawing
find.f_drawing.text: A coloured pencil drawing: a house, the sun and Grandpa with a huge brush. He kept it in a desk drawer under a sheet of tracing paper, like a real painting.
find.f_palette.title: Paint palette
find.f_palette.text: A palette with dried paint: honey, sage green and a warm red. Grandpa painted everything he fixed in these colours.
find.f_sign.title: Sketch of a sign
find.f_sign.text: A sketch of a sign for the workshop: the letters have nearly faded, but you can see how carefully Grandpa drew every flourish.
find.f_apron.title: Paint-stained apron
find.f_apron.text: An apron stained in every colour hangs on a nail. It seems Grandpa painted not only furniture but himself too, and didn't mind one bit.
find.f_brush.title: Old brush
find.f_brush.text: An old brush with its handle wrapped in tape. Grandpa even mended what he painted with, and it still lays down an even coat.
final.paint.title: The workshop is alive again
final.paint.text: It smells of wood and fresh paint, the clock is ticking, the radio plays softly. Both rooms are full of life again, and the workshop's story goes on. Thank you for being here.
intro.paint.title: Paint room
intro.paint.text: This is where Grandpa painted what he fixed. This room has its own parts: paints. Matching paints combine on the table just like fasteners.
story.city.title: The city
story.city.text: Alarm, metro, work, metro again. Every day looks the same, and even weekends rush by.
story.key.title: The key
story.key.text: One evening, an old key turns up in a desk drawer, with a cardboard tag: "Workshop". Grandpa left it as an inheritance, and there was never time to go.
story.road.title: The decision
story.road.text: Enough putting it off. The bag is packed, the morning bus ticket bought. Somewhere in a quiet village, Grandpa's workshop is waiting.
story.arrival.title: Arrival
story.arrival.text: The door creaks. Inside: dust, boxes and the smell of old wood. Everything starts over here — with the pile of junk by the door.
